'''February 2001 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG booster draft held in TJ's Collectibles, Milford, MA on 24 February 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1779">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-milford-ma-2-24-01d1779/ milford-ma-2-24-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 25 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-25-milford-ma-2-24-01d1779/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 24 February 2001
* '''Site:''' TJ's Collectibles, Milford, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Reflections II Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* Kris Earle counts 14 players ('eventually got up to 14'); the hub gives 11 from Hayes Hunter's report. Earle lists Michael Schiemer 6 (+40); Schiemer's own report gives 6 (+37).<ref name="tr-d1939" />
